description: You cannot humble me, my life has been built on love. #selfacceptance #selflove #selfcare
transcript: I am treated extremely well by the people in my life, friends, family, colleagues, the people around me think bigger for me than I could possibly think for myself. So I'm very observant when new things come into my life, when things begin to knock at my internal world. I know immediately when something does not work for me because I know what it feels like to feel really good. I know what it feels like to have people in your life that when you are slipping, push you back up so you cannot come into my life and humble me or make me feel like I'm not deserving of the life that I've worked hard for. I come from a space of love and you cannot come into my life and not love me.
